row:
Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Trebaluger Equine Rescue Centre, a non-profit sanctuary in Menorca, Spain, dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and providing a forever home for abandoned, abused, and neglected horses, ponies, donkeys, and mules. 

Founded in 2018 by Samantha Lake after she witnessed the heartbreaking reality of equine abandonment on this island of horse lovers, Trebaluger offers these animals a permanent, safe, and loving place to live freely. Today, we care for over 30 equines and lots of cats, chickens, ducks, a pig, and a dog. 

Every view, share, and subscription directly supports our mission: food, veterinary expenses, and maintaining our stables, water systems, and fences. We believe every equine deserves a happy, healthy life free from fear and neglect. 

📍 Located at Cami De Ses Cometes, Trebaluger, Es Castell, Menorca  
🕒 Open daily 9:30–12:00 for visits  
🔔 Subscribe and join our community of compassion, because together, we rescue and give hope
